label: mid-input positions (t=3-6) of sequences that start with y
explanation: Fires almost only during the original input phase at positions 3-7 (peak t=4-5, ~85% of mass), plus weakly on the <DEL> step of short sequences. Strongly conditioned on the first original token being y (20.7x lift, 77% of mass; first token 1 is a weaker secondary at 12%). Within y-initial sequences it is sparse (~8% of eligible steps fire). It is strongest the step right after a d (prev_tok d, 11.7x), and after v, x or 1 two steps back. Top examples look like y 1 v d [z] and y 1 x d [w]. Current tokens z, m, w and b fire somewhat more. Never fires in the copy phase or at t<3. The predicate first_tok==y & original phase & t in 3..6 captures ~74% of mass but with low precision. Adding a seen-token condition (d/v/x/1/s/w/f/c seen at least twice) only raises F1 to ~0.31, so the exact prefix conjunction is not captured.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=y (+8.65), prev_tok=d (+5.99), orig0=1 (+5.79), orig1=1 (+3.81), orig0=g (+3.44), orig0=j (+3.16). Lower it: correct=1 (-5.63), prev3_tok=- (-4.69), orig_idx=-1 (-4.02), t=8 (-3.65).
